response.justification: Bogdan presents an extensive and diverse engineering background, exceeding the 15 years of experience requirement. His recent work at re:cinq directly involves AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling, which is a strong match for the AI expertise needed. Coupled with his entrepreneurial experience as a founder and a clear commitment to technical leadership through knowledge sharing and open-source contributions, he demonstrates many qualities essential for a Principal Engineer. While explicit "AI strategy" and "customer advisory" experience is less pronounced, his deep technical foundation and innovative mindset suggest high potential for this aspect of the role.
strengths: Extensive 18+ years of diverse software engineering experience, exceeding the minimum.
Direct and recent experience with AI-agent infrastructure and agentic workflows.
Demonstrated technical leadership, entrepreneurial drive, and commitment to knowledge sharing.
concerns: Lack of explicit "Director-level" title or direct experience in large-scale organizational AI strategy.
Limited explicit experience advising strategic external customers/partners on AI adoption.
No advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in an AI-related field, which was a preferred qualification.
